title: A page that stops writing after a log-off shows no notice that edits are not saved
evidence: Done (US-09 AC2i): a device or fallback page whose writes stopped shows 'This page has stopped saving. Reload it to carry on.' in LocalSaveAlert (bar and phone tabs); a cloud page shows nothing, since its saves still reach its cloud. Was: A device page whose health writes stop (healthWritesAllowed false, widget-src/src/lib/storage.ts; since PR 1417 also a page whose load falls back to the device after the log-off id changed) shows nothing. LocalStorageAdapter.writeSync throws before noteRecordSave (widget-src/src/storage/local-storage-adapter.ts), so localSaveRefused stays false and the LOCAL_SAVE_REFUSED alert (widget-src/standalone/sync-control.tsx) never shows; the storage bar fixes a local page's status at 'saved' and labels it 'Sign in' (or the reconnect label); useProfileSave marks the change saved and clean (widget-src/src/hooks/useProfileSave.ts); useMatrixDraft drops the draft. Typed values stay on screen as if saved. A page that opens after a log-off from another page shows an empty record and saves nothing, so it looks like a fresh start. A cloud page that stops keeps saving to its cloud, so only its device mirror is refused. Candidate words: 'You logged off in another tab. Changes here are not saved. Reload to continue.'
